description: A little bit of curiosity is all we need . Just a bunch of space enthusiasts trying to take our ideas from Terra to Luna!  Learning, building, experimenting, and probably getting lost in space facts along the way.
summary:
PROJECT ASTRA– A Journey Beyond Earth

What does it take to survive beyond Earth?

Terra to Luna is an interactive educational game designed to introduce students to the challenges of establishing and managing a human outpost on the Moon. It transforms the complexities of space exploration into an engaging experience where players step into the role of mission planners and make critical decisions that determine the success of their lunar mission.

From maintaining life-support systems and managing power resources to ensuring radiation protection and sustaining food production, players must carefully balance limited resources while keeping their lunar outpost operational. Every decision comes with a consequence, encouraging players to think critically, solve problems, and understand the engineering trade-offs involved in real-world space missions.

More than just a game, Terra to Luna bridges the gap between learning and exploration. It makes complex scientific concepts easier to understand through interactive challenges, decision-making, and hands-on experimentation.

Our vision is to inspire young minds to look beyond Earth, explore the possibilities of human space exploration, and discover the science behind building a sustainable future beyond our planet.

From one small planet to endless possibilities — our journey begins with Terra to Luna. 🌙🚀
details:
Project Details – Project Astra🌍🚀

Project Astra is an interactive educational game designed to introduce students to the challenges of establishing and managing a sustainable human outpost on the Moon. Our project transforms complex space engineering concepts into an engaging, hands-on learning experience where players take on the role of lunar mission planners.

The game places players in the challenging environment of a lunar outpost, where they must make important decisions and balance four essential aspects of survival: life support, radiation shielding, power management, and food production. Each decision influences the overall condition and sustainability of the outpost, helping players understand how limited resources, unexpected challenges, and engineering trade-offs affect the success of a space mission.

How it works: Players interact with mission scenarios, manage available resources, and make strategic decisions to keep their lunar outpost functioning. Through these challenges, they learn that successful space exploration requires careful planning, resource management, teamwork, and problem-solving.

Benefits and intended impact: Terra to Luna makes space science more accessible and interesting to young learners. It encourages critical thinking, decision-making, scientific curiosity, and awareness of the challenges astronauts may face during long-duration missions. By turning theoretical concepts into interactive experiences, we aim to inspire students to explore STEM fields and develop an interest in space exploration.

Creativity and innovation: Instead of simply presenting information about lunar missions, our project allows students to experience the responsibility of managing an outpost themselves. The combination of interactive gameplay, resource management, and real-world space exploration concepts creates an engaging learning environment.

Development tools and technologies:
React.js: For building the interactive user interface and application structure.

JavaScript: For implementing game logic, interactions, and dynamic functionality.

HTML5: For structuring the application.

CSS3: For styling, layouts, and responsive design.

Visual Studio Code: For writing and managing the project code.

Web Browser: For running and testing the application.

While developing Project Astra, we considered the importance of scientific relevance, age-appropriate learning, simplicity, accessibility, and an engaging user experience. Our goal was to create an experience that makes the challenges of living beyond Earth easier to understand while keeping the excitement of space exploration alive.

From Project Astra, we believe every great space explorer starts with curiosity.
